headline: On last trading day, Sensex gained over 100 points as Nifty reclaimed 25,000 led by banking stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: NSE and BSE are closed today, 10 November 2026, for the Diwali-Balipratipada holiday.
In the last trading session, Indian equities logged modest gains after recovering from early profit-taking.
Strong performance in banking and pharmaceutical stocks helped Nifty reclaim the 25,000 mark.
Softening crude oil prices provided underlying support to domestic market sentiment.
whatHappening: Larsen & Toubro secured an order valued between ₹1,000 crore and ₹2,500 crore for Noida Metro's Aqua Line extension.
Data Patterns shares jumped 9% during the last trading session.
HCL Tech and Bharti Airtel featured among the top laggards in the market.
Equity markets will resume regular trading on Wednesday, 11 November 2026.
summary:
Indian stock markets are closed today for Diwali-Balipratipada and will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.
In the last trading session, Sensex and Nifty ended higher with Nifty reclaiming the 25,000 level.
Banking and pharmaceutical stocks led the market gains, alongside order wins for L&T.
